prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universal “best” — the right HVAC company depends on your location in Houston, the problem, your budget, and whether you need emergency service or a long-term service plan. I can find highly rated local contractors for you, but first:

Quick questions
- What ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?
- Is this an emergency (no cooling now) or a routine repair/inspection?
- Any preferences (brand experience, price sensitivity, same‑day service, financing, warranties)?

How I’ll pick recommendations
- Valid Texas HVAC license and insurance
- NATE-certified technicians (or equivalent)
- Strong recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi)
- Good BBB rating and transparent pricing/written estimates
- Same‑day/emergency availability if needed
- Parts/warranty coverage and clear labor warranty

If you want to choose on your own, here are quick tips and questions to ask any contractor
- Ask for license number and verify with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation.
- Ask how long they’ve been servicing Houston and experience with your system brand.
- Request a written estimate with parts, labor, and warranty details.
- Ask if techs are NATE-certified and background-checked.
- Get at least two estimates for major repairs or replacements.
- Red flags: very lowball quotes, pressure to replace immediately without diagnosis, no written estimate or no warranty.

If you give me your ZIP code and whether this is urgent, I’ll pull a short list (3–5) of top-rated Houston HVAC companies for AC repair and a brief note on each.
